full_prompt_en: A square, spare surreal painting places a dark hat-wearing figure in the lower left before a low, open landscape beneath an immense green-blue sky. The sky fills more than half the frame in broad horizontal swathes of deep teal, muted green, and gray. Near the horizon, a narrow pale band passes from soft pink through cream into smoky blue, separating the dark upper field from the earth below. The figure has a small, almost featureless black face with two bright yellow eyes under a wide brown hat. A dark coat and lighter triangular collar fade into the brown and charcoal foreground, while one pale hand rises near the center-left with the fingers spread. The body is much less clearly bounded than the hat, eyes, and hand, giving the figure a suspended, uncanny presence rather than a conventional portrait finish. Along the low horizon, a tiny line of warm yellow-orange marks appears at the far left. Slightly right of center, a small dark rooflike shape sits among similarly warm broken marks. The middle ground is a thin, blurred run of dusty mauve, tan, and ochre; the foreground below becomes a rough, dark green-brown band with short scratched strokes and scattered light flecks. There are no sharp perspective lines or detailed objects to explain the open ground. Broad horizontal brush sweeps structure the sky, and scraping or dry pigment interrupts the darker lower colors. Light appears as a subdued horizon glow, strongest behind the figure and the distant marks; the hat and torso remain nearly black, while the eyes and hand form isolated bright accents. The overall composition feels quiet and disquieting, balancing a huge color field against a small, enigmatic presence and a fragile strip of land.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形、简省而超现实的绘画把戴深色帽子的人物放在左下方，前方是低矮开阔的土地，上方压着广大的青绿色天空。天空以深青蓝、低饱和绿和灰色的大幅横向色带占据画面过半。靠近地平线，一条狭窄浅色带从柔粉、奶油色过渡到烟蓝，把深色上部与下方土地分开。人物在宽大的棕帽下有一张小小的、几乎没有面部细节的黑脸，两只眼睛发着亮黄光。深色外套和较浅的三角形领口渐渐融入棕色、炭灰色前景，一只浅色手在画面中左部举起，手指张开。身体的界线远不如帽子、眼睛和手清楚，使人物呈现悬置、奇异的存在感，而非传统肖像的完整刻画。低处地平线上，最左侧有一小串暖黄橙色笔痕。中央略偏右，一块小小的深色屋顶状形体处在同样温暖、断续的笔痕之间。中景是一条灰紫、棕褐与赭色的薄而模糊的色带；下方前景则化为粗糙的深绿棕区域，带短促刮痕和零星浅色颗粒。这里没有清晰透视线或细密物件解释空旷地面。宽阔的横向笔扫组织天空，刮擦或干涩颜料打断下方深色。光以克制的地平线辉光出现，在人物背后和远处色痕上最明显；帽子和身体仍近乎黑色，眼睛与手成为孤立亮点。整体构图安静而令人不安，让巨大的色域与小小的神秘存在及脆弱的土地窄带相平衡。
style_prompt_en: The painting favors broad horizontal color fields, rubbed pigment, and sparse, startling accents. Deep teal, green-black, smoky gray, and earthen brown occupy most of the surface, interrupted by a thin mauve and cream interval and a few concentrated yellow-orange lights. Forms emerge only partially from the ground, with some contours crisp enough to arrest the eye and others dissolving into scraped or smeared surroundings. Flattened space and a low band of activity leave extensive weight in the upper field. Dry marks and grain keep the large dark areas materially present rather than blank. Illumination is a distant, muted glow; tiny bright points carry more force than broad highlights. The overall visual effect is enigmatic, restrained, and atmospheric, with emptiness as active as the few focal marks.
style_prompt_zh: 这种绘画偏重大幅横向色域、磨蹭过的颜料和稀少而惊人的强调点。深青蓝、绿黑、烟灰与土棕占据绝大多数表面，被一条细窄的灰紫与奶油色间隔和几个集中的黄橙亮点打断。形体只从底色中部分浮现，有些轮廓清楚到足以抓住目光，有些则消散在刮擦、抹开的周围区域里。压平的空间与低处活动带让上部色域显得格外有重量。干涩痕迹和颗粒使大片暗部仍具物质存在感，而非空白。照明是远处克制的辉光，小亮点比宽阔高光更有力量。整体视觉效果神秘、收敛且富于氛围，留白与少数焦点笔痕同样主动。
theme_en: A dark hat-wearing figure with bright eyes before a low, sparse landscape
theme_zh: 一个戴深色帽子、眼睛发亮的暗色人物站在低矮而空旷的风景前
name: Sidney Nolan
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
